takes place on a sandy island in the middle of the ocean. Small patches of grass can be seen on the ground, which have palm trees growing on them. Multiple stone mounts can be found on the map, which act as cliff spaces. There are also a few wooden beach huts and red crabs on the map.
The black path starts and ends at two grassy caves with the path weaving around grassy mounds.
